messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: HIGH latency for inference-api-hotpath (us-west). p99=1050ms over 6m, SLO burn ~34%. PD incident INC-2026-324 — https://grafana.redwood/alerts/INC-2026-324

alice: Ack @incident-bot — I'm oncall, starting triage.

bob: Checking autoscaler events and kv-cache eviction logs now. Will report back in 1–2m.

carla: FYI we rolled model v2.1 to canary yesterday ~23:05 UTC (small quantized fallback enabled). Could be sticky KV mismatch or new kernel path.

dan: Support reports: 2 enterprise customers filed slow-response tickets; one saw retries/timeouts. No error spike in API errors yet, mostly latency.

evan: Infra: sidecar batcher CPU pegged on pod inference-3, high read/write queue length. `kubectl top pod inference-3` shows CPU ~98%.

alice: Quick mitigation — reducing batcher max_batch_size to 8 to drop latency spike. Patching config now: `kubectl patch configmap batcher-config -p '{"data":{"max_batch_size":"8"}}'`.

bob: Also going to enable routing fallback to v2-quant for heavy requests (>2k tokens). Rolling 10% traffic now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: routed escalation to bob. (reaction :eyes:)

carla: Can we warm KV cache before shifting more traffic? Triggering preload for top keys: `scripts/preload_kv.sh us-west 500` — kicked off.

alice: Applied batcher patch and rolled the sidecar on inference-3 (drain -> restart). Observing p99 drop to ~620ms within 30s.

evan: Spinning up +2 replicas in the dedicated pool: `scale-gpu --pool inference-dedicated --replicas 12` (was 10). ETA ~90s for new nodes to join.

bob: Routing change deployed (10% -> v2-quant). Live metrics: p99 -> 470ms, p95 -> 110ms trending steady for last 60s. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/xyz/inference-hotpath

dan: Customer update: notified affected accounts, advised retry/backoff & temporary throttling. No data-loss; impact limited to increased latency for a subset of large payloads.

alice: Good progress. Keeping watch for 10m. If stable, we'll de-escalate and file a follow-up postmortem (focus: batcher saturation + model canary interaction). Handing off monitoring to eng-sre for post-incident work. :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: Alert resolved — no active pages. Incident INC-2026-324 status: mitigated. Post-incident ticket: https://jira.redwood/browse/INC-2026-324
